title: Citrate-Phosphate Buffer Preparation
author: Neilier Junior
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfydjps6

steps.title: Prepare citric acid solution
steps.instruction: Weigh 19.21 g of citric acid (MW 192.1 g·mol⁻¹) per litre to obtain a 0.1 M solution and dissolve in deionized water.

steps.title: Prepare sodium phosphate solution
steps.instruction: Choose either dibasic sodium phosphate dihydrate (35.6 g L⁻¹, MW 178.0 g·mol⁻¹) or heptahydrate (53.6 g L⁻¹, MW 268.0 g·mol⁻¹) to make a 0.2 M solution; weigh the appropriate amount per litre and dissolve in deionized water.

steps.title: Mix buffer components
steps.instruction: Combine the citric‑acid and sodium‑phosphate solutions in the proportions required for the desired pH (2.6–7.0), then add deionized water to bring the total volume to exactly 100 mL.

steps.title: Adjust final pH
steps.instruction: Measure the pH with a calibrated sensitive pH meter and adjust, if necessary, by adding small amounts of the acid or phosphate solutions until the target pH is reached.
